description:
Use this when the user asks how much of an Indian stock's traded volume was taken for delivery, and how that has trended.

Get the delivery-volume / delivery-percentage trend for an Indian stock.

    Accepts NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code. `days` (1..1825) bounds the lookback window.
    Returns the raw delivery quantity and delivery % time series from the NSE bhavcopy.
name: get_delivery_trends
title: Delivery volume trend
